who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), wave-1124-sansio, the blaze-format-core and blaze-format allocator port
where: crates/blaze-format-core/src/lib.rs (root attributes), declared.rs and verified.rs (the exported `record!` and `__record_fields!`)
what: C7 asks for `#![blaze::sans_io]` at a crate's root. blaze-format-core defines `#[macro_export]` macros that call each other by `$crate::__record_fields!`. rustc treats a crate whose root carries a tool inner attribute as macro-expanded and then refuses that path (`macro_expanded_macro_exports_accessed_by_absolute_paths`, rust-lang/rust#52234), so the attribute went on each module that defines no exported macro instead, as blaze-sim does. Nothing was compiled to confirm this; it follows the comment already in blaze-sim.
cost: about twenty minutes reading blaze-sim's root to find why it carries the attribute per module
cause: the gate's sans_io check reads the root only, and rustc's macro-expanded heuristic counts a tool inner attribute
fix: the gate should accept `#![blaze::sans_io]` on every module of a crate that exports macros, or blaze-lints should read a crate-level marker that is not an inner attribute (a Cargo metadata key)
